messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: release/2026.03.22-e2 (f12a9) -> prod/apac1. Running post-deploy smoke + synthetic probes.

Marta: Noticed synthetic queue-depth probe elevated on apac1 canary nodes; probe p95 for /v1/route increased from 320ms -> 1.1s and probe queue depth avg doubled. No global 5xx yet. cc @Ishaan

Ishaan: Could be batching change in new runtime that lets large requests block small ones. Any specific request mix?

Marta: Synth mix skewed heavier to multi-turn session tests. The queued batches show a couple of large long-seq requests occupying batches.

Priya: Mitigation options: 1) pin route in apac1 to previous modelvariant `serve-stable-20260315`, 2) apply batching cap on canary pool (max_batch_items=8), 3) pause rollout in apac1. Prefer pin+cap.

Marta: Agreed. I'll pin and apply cap. Running: 
```
rbctl pin-route --region=apac1 --service=chat --to=model:serve-stable-20260315 --reason="postdeploy queue-depth tail" --duration=90m
rbctl update-pool --region=apac1 --pool=canary --set=max_batch_items=8
```

infra-bot: infra-bot: route pin applied by Marta at 1778882240. Pool config updated. Telemetry: https://internal.redwood/obs/canary/1778882223

Ishaan: Quick A/B (1k requests) after pin+cap: p95 -> 340ms. Queue depth normalized. No 502s reproduced.

Marta: Pausing rollout in apac1 at current percent (10%). Adding watch: p95(chat, apac1) > 500ms for 5m -> pager.

Priya: Updating release notes: "apac1: paused canary (10%) due to queue-depth tail. Route pinned to serve-stable-20260315; batching cap applied. Watch 90m."

deploy-bot: Canary paused in apac1. To resume: `deploy resume --region=apac1 --percent=25`. To revert: `deploy revert --to=release/2026.03.20`.

Marta: Team, please hold on further rollouts until ML/runtime perf team confirms batching semantics. Will post follow-up in 45m. :mag_right:
